deprecation_reason: This run used Friday dates and inferred rebalance-time Top-1 rankings by back-projecting later SEC snapshot market values. Direct 2018 and 2021 raw-snapshot audits showed that this reconstruction can reverse rankings and is not an authoritative rebalance-weight source. The Leto Monday-date sequence has since been extracted directly from the source video and independently reproduced.
historical_note: Retained only as provenance for the discarded snapshot back-projection approach. Do not use this file as the SPMO Top-1 strategy result.
